info.title: ELNAVO Commerce API
info.description: Implemented React/Express commerce API. COD is the only active payment method; SSLCommerz is deferred. Mutations require an opaque session cookie and X-CSRF-Token. Start with GET /auth/csrf. Admin operations require ADMIN and MFA in production. Money is serialized as integer minor-unit strings. Listing requests default to 12 products and return pagination metadata. Guest carts are local; syncing, quoting and ordering require authentication.
